rationale: Builds on the 1.5111 recurrent-tail baseline by applying one surgical runtime patch to state/best_script.py: the loop no longer runs the redundant last-step validation pass when VAL_LOSS_EVERY=0. That preserves the architecture, optimizer, quant-aware endgame, and final_int8_zlib_roundtrip_exact scorer while spending the end budget on training plus the required exact int8+zlib evaluation instead of an extra pre-save validation.
title: Exact-Only Final Evaluation Stop
